events.description: 45. MINUTE entry before the Honorable John F. Kness: Plaintiffs' unopposed motion 44 for a second extension of time is denied. First off, FRCP 6(b) requires a showing of good cause for any extension of time. But where, as here, the due date has expired (Plaintiffs' response was due 5/12/2025), the movant must also show excusable neglect. Plaintiffs' present, taciturn motion addresses neither of these standards. Second, the present motion is internally inconsistent: Plaintiffs first ask for a 21-day extension, then, in the prayer for relief, they ask for 30 days. In view of these deficiencies, the motion is denied. If Plaintiffs wish to renew their motion, they must correct the errors discussed above or risk losing the ability to respond substantively to the motion to dismiss. Mailed notice. (exr, ) (Entered: 05/16/2025)
